To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose a novel model that can generate appropriate emotional responses for dialogue systems, (2) we show that the model can generate emotionally consistent responses, and (3), we show that the proposed method can improve the quality of generated responses.

we propose a model that can generate responses not only in the content (relevant and grammar) but also in the emotion (emotionally appropriate) and we show that the model is superior to other state-of-the-art baselines.

we proposed a new method for emotional conversation generation that models emotion expressions, internal emotion states, external emotion vocabulary, and their relationships, and that we demonstrated the superiority of our method over the baseline methods.
